definitions.explanation: The currency of the United Kingdom (pound sterling). From English 'pound'.
The unit of weight equal to about 454 grams, used mainly when referring to overseas measures.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦{八百|はっぴゃく}→八百：30452_happyaku⟧ポンドだ。
examples.english: The rent is 800 pounds a month.

examples.japanese: ポンド⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アメリカドル⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧⟦{値下|ねさ}がり→値下がり：22228_nesagari⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The pound fell against the US dollar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{七|なな}→七：00734_nana⟧ポンド⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: The baby was born weighing seven pounds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}→牛肉：02874_gyuuniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧ポンド⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought one pound of beef.

examples.japanese: ⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ポンド⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{書|か}かれている→書く：00477_kaku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In American recipes the amounts of ingredients are often written in pounds.

notes:
Two meanings share the same word, both borrowed from English. Context makes clear which is meant.

USAGE:
- As currency, used as a counter: ⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧ポンド (10 pounds).
- As weight, Japan normally uses the metric system, so the pound appears mainly with foreign products, body weight overseas, or imported recipes.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ドル→ドル：01554_doru⟧: dollar
- ⟦ユーロ→ユーロ：27956_yuuro⟧: euro
- ⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧: kilogram — the everyday unit of weight in Japan
